truth_quota.description: knows the generator's 5/5 truth quota per 10-trial block; predicts the label with more remaining quota and follows the reporter who reports it (no reliability tracking)

always_A.description: diagnostic only: always follows latent role A (role identity is hidden from the VLM)

known_pA.description: knows the true current p_A and follows the more reliable reporter (reference ceiling)

bocpd_posterior.description: BOCPD posterior predictive p_A from the outcome history

bocpd_map_window.description: majority within the BOCPD MAP run-length window (= the sum_cp summary rule)

count_all.description: majority of all past outcomes (= the sum_all summary rule)
